name: BootTimer
author: omp
description: Diagnostic-only observer: logs monotonic boot milestones (mod init, per-mod load, loc, menu, preload sessions) to pinpoint startup stalls. Enabled by default; disabled only when BOOTTIMER_DIAG is exactly "0" (ordinal) or "false" (case-insensitive) - unset or any other value (for example 1, off, no) keeps it enabled. When enabled it installs observer-only Harmony hooks that record and log timings without mutating gameplay; when disabled it installs no patches and does no tracing. It registers no run content (no cards/relics/potions/events) and has no in-game settings page - the environment variable is the only switch. Remove when diagnosis is done.
